media.title: No media yet
media.body: Drop video, audio or images here, or press Ctrl+I to import.

audio.title: No audio yet
audio.body: Music, sound effects and voiceovers appear here. Import a file or record a voiceover.

text.title: Text styles
text.body: Titles, lower thirds and subtitles appear here once the text library is installed.

stickers.title: Stickers
stickers.body: Stickers and shapes you add to a project appear here.

effects.title: Effects
effects.body: Effects you can apply to a clip appear here, grouped by what they change.

transitions.title: Transitions
transitions.body: Transitions between two clips appear here. Select a cut on the timeline to apply one.

filters.title: Filters
filters.body: Color looks and filters appear here, with a strength slider in the inspector.

templates.title: Templates
templates.body: Project templates and compositions appear here. Start from one to skip the setup.

captions.title: Captions
captions.body: Generate captions from speech or import an SRT file. Caption styles appear here.

ai-studio.title: AI Studio
ai-studio.body: Generate clips, images and voices. Each action shows its cost and model before it runs.

preview.emptyBody: Add a clip to the timeline and the frame at the playhead shows here.

inspector.emptyBody: Select a clip on the timeline to edit its position, scale, opacity and effects.

timeline.emptyBody: Drag a clip from Media onto a track to start cutting.

reason.overlap: It would overlap another clip on that track. Drop it on a free spot.
reason.locked: The track is locked. Unlock it to edit its clips.
reason.inGesture: Someone else is editing this clip right now. Try again in a moment.
reason.changed: The project changed while you were editing. Try again.
reason.interrupted: The edit was interrupted and undone. Try again.

restarted.damaged: The journal ended with a damaged entry; everything before it is back.
restarted.untitled: Changes to the untitled project were not kept. Save it to a project folder so a restart can restore them.

blocked.failedBody: Editing is paused. Choose Restart in the engine dialog to continue, or quit Cutweave. Changes to a saved project are kept in its journal.
blocked.mismatchTitle: This editor does not match the engine
blocked.mismatchBody: Editing is off so nothing changes by mistake. Install matching versions of Cutweave and its engine. Engine {{version}}.
